text: $agent-seat  make a substation transformer like seen here [Image #1] do not edit the current one in the studio, i am comparing the outputs across models, so it would not represent any of your capability to edit their work
resolution: Created a separate Studio model document named Substation Transformer - Codex rather than editing the comparison model. Built a meter-scale industrial transformer with a grounded main tank and lid, twin radiator-fin banks and headers, three cooling fans, conservator with supports and oil indicator, three high-voltage bushings, three low-voltage bushings, a neutral bushing, control cabinet and panel details, Buchholz relay, bypass valve, and system ground terminal. Applied an industrial green-gray/porcelain/metal palette, saved through the Agent Seat, and verified semantic persistence healthy across saved, mount, and resident horizons: 4104/4104 named faces, 154 saved regions, zero unnamed faces. No repository commit was made because game 3D models must not be committed.
